description: This file contains unit tests for the NiaPreferencesDataSource class, focusing on user preferences management such as onboarding visibility and dynamic color usage.

classes.name: NiaPreferencesDataSourceTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of NiaPreferencesDataSource in managing user preferences.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test subject before each test method runs.

methods.name: shouldHideOnboardingIsFalseByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the onboarding should be hidden is false by default.

methods.name: userShouldHideOnboardingIsTrueWhenSet
methods.description: Checks that setting shouldHideOnboarding to true reflects correctly.

methods.name: userShouldHideOnboarding_unfollowsLastTopic_shouldHideOnboardingIsFalse
methods.description: Ensures that unfollowing the last topic resets the onboarding visibility to show again.

methods.name: userShouldHideOnboarding_unfollowsAllTopics_shouldHideOnboardingIsFalse
methods.description: Checks that unfollowing all topics resets the onboarding visibility to show again.

methods.name: shouldUseDynamicColorFalseByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the useDynamicColor preference defaults to false.

methods.name: userShouldUseDynamicColorIsTrueWhenSet
methods.description: Verifies that setting useDynamicColor to true is reflected correctly.
